name: Advent No. 3
source:
Humanity hides from the Colossi behind towering walls, where oppression has replaced hope, and the protagonist’s pursuit of truth uncovers secrets for which no one is prepared.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Advent_No._3]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
人类躲在高墙后面躲避巨像，压迫取代了希望，主角对真理的追求揭开了无人准备的秘密。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Advent_No._3]romance-club.fandom[/url]
